name: Seemeeu Vis en Chips
address: 65 Lang St, Bergsig, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Proper fish and chips in Great Brak River, where locals queue for crispy hake and generous portions.
description_long:
Tucked away on Lang Street in Bergsig, Seemeeu Vis en Chips has earned its reputation as the go-to spot for honest fish and chips done right. The menu keeps things simple – fresh hake, calamari, and prawns fried to golden perfection, served with proper hand-cut chips and all the traditional trimmings.

What sets this place apart is the consistent quality and generous portions that keep locals coming back. The batter is light and crispy, never greasy, and the fish is always fresh. It's primarily a takeaway operation, perfect for grabbing a parcel to enjoy at the nearby lagoon or beach. The service is friendly and efficient, even when the queue stretches out the door on busy weekends.

Located in Great Brak River between George and Mossel Bay, it's worth the short detour off the N2. Expect to wait during peak times – a good sign that you're onto something special. Cash and card accepted, and they're happy to cater for larger orders with advance notice.
